title: Full boxes and parts left over
brief: FullBoxes shows how many full boxes the parts make (Parts divided by PerBox, a whole number) and LeftOver the parts that do not fill a box (the remainder). If PerBox is 0 there is nothing to divide by: the Per box is 0 light comes on, the displays keep their last numbers, and the PLC keeps running.
hints: DIV gives the whole number of boxes; MOD gives the remainder.
Put GT PerBox 0 in front of DIV and MOD, so they never divide by 0.

assertions.says: 50 parts at 12 a box fill 4 boxes (48 parts).
50 - 48 leaves 2 parts over: MOD gives the remainder.
100 parts at 8 a box fill 12 boxes (96 parts).
With Parts per box at 0 the warning light should be lit, and the PLC should still be running.
With 6 per box the warning should go out.
50 parts at 6 a box fill 8 boxes. If the displays are blank, the PLC stopped with a math fault when it divided by 0.
